verdict.rationale: Recurring scheduling is a fair question for an inference and training platform, but the evidence only shows one-off actions. Async inference requests, Training Jobs and Chains workflows are all launched on demand, and nothing documents a cron, scheduler or recurring trigger. A one-off async or training job is not a recurring schedule, so the axis applies but is unsupported.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
